resepignev

Since it was an accident, I did not record or what so ever.

Yes [Here]

I just make this appeal so it's formal. Also if the appeal gets accepted, I would prefer if you could remove the kick instead to appeal it.

replies.author: RIP_Avicus
replies.body:
In fairness to Flo, he did say after I kicked him that it was an accident. All that happened is that me and another mod (can't remeber who) got spleefed. I saw the message in the chat, and kicked him. 
I was running up thensky bridge, and I had a player right in front of me, blocking my visibility. So, in fairness, I didn't actually see Flo do it. 
That's just what happened on my screen.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body: Are we appealing infractions of other players who did it by accident?
replies.body_tagged: Are we appealing infractions of other players who did it by accident?

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Normally players don't get appealed, except they have evidence.
Since the Mod (Oscar) that kicked me confirmed, that he didn't see that I was spleefing him or other players, he just saw the message popping up; And just the message doesn't warrants a punishment. 
Also after talking to him (as he states), he agrees that it was an accident, so I have evidence that it wasn't intentional.

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body: Right, but if somebody did it by accident to another person, are we appealing them?
replies.body_tagged: Right, but if somebody did it by accident to another person, are we appealing them?

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body: The point of a punishment is to correct a player's behavior. If the player did nothing wrong, I see no reason to keep a punishment. There'd be no behavior to correct.
replies.body_tagged: The point of a punishment is to correct a player's behavior. If the player did nothing wrong, I see no reason to keep a punishment. There'd be no behavior to correct.

replies.body:
I imagine we'd treat them the same way we'd treat a Moderator in case their infraction is also false and they want to appeal it, as resepignev did.

It really depends on whether they want to appeal it or not, the decision is theirs.

replies.author: rinn
replies.body: In my opinion, since Oscar only saw that he was spleefed in the chat and didn't really see it happen, in addition to the fact that Oscar vouched for his own dealt infraction to be appealed, I think the infraction should be deleted. Also, since Flo was a Mod at the time, although this may sound biased, I don't think it's right to deal an infraction to a Moderator without proper consultation and confirmation. Anyway, I'll see what the others have to say.
